---
title: "scale_pose_discrete()"
subtitle: "Identity scale for the pose aesthetic"
toc: false
---

## Description

Pose names are also the values the aesthetic takes, so the default scale
passes them through unchanged. `scale_pose_discrete()` is that identity
scale. Use it to set a title, labels or limits for a mapped `pose`.

## Usage

```r
scale_pose_discrete(..., guide = "legend")
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `...` | Arguments passed on to `scale_discrete_identity()`, such as `name`, `labels` or `limits`. |
| `guide` | A guide specification. Defaults to `"legend"`. |

## Value

A ggplot2 scale.

## Details

ggplot2 looks for a default scale named `scale_<aesthetic>_<type>` in the
environment of the `ggplot()` call. For a discrete aesthetic called
`pose`, that is `scale_pose_discrete()`. The package defines it, so mapping
`pose` works as soon as `library(geomfeliscatus)` is attached.

## Examples

```r
poses <- data.frame(x = seq_along(cat_poses()), y = 1, pose = cat_poses())

ggplot(poses, aes(x, y, pose = pose)) +
  geom_cat(size = 20) +
  scale_pose_discrete(name = "Pose", labels = toupper)
```

```r
# Restrict which poses appear
ggplot(poses, aes(x, y, pose = pose)) +
  geom_cat(size = 20) +
  scale_pose_discrete(limits = c("sitting", "curled"))
```
